tips.title: Buy in Bulk at the Palengke
tips.body: Purchase vegetables and fruits in bulk during peak season when prices are lower. Store properly to extend freshness.

tips.title: Shop Early Morning for Fresh Produce
tips.body: Visit the palengke early in the morning for the freshest produce and better prices before the rush.

tips.title: Unplug Appliances When Not in Use
tips.body: Phantom loads from plugged-in appliances can add up. Unplug devices or use power strips to save on electricity.

tips.title: Use LED Bulbs
tips.body: Replace traditional bulbs with LED lights. They use 75% less energy and last 25 times longer.

tips.title: Use Beep Cards for Discounts
tips.body: Load your Beep card to get discounts on MRT, LRT, and participating bus routes.

tips.title: Carpool with Colleagues
tips.body: Share rides with coworkers to split fuel costs and reduce your daily commute expenses.
